correctness.rationale: For every positive parameter and \(0<\alpha<1\), \(Q\) is strictly decreasing; \(H\) has at most one maximum and two zeros. The boundary \(\eta\le2/(1-\alpha)\) forces \(Q(0)<0\); above it a constructive positive-parameter selection yields two zeros before the buoyancy cutoff. Exact rational signs \(F(0)=-203\), \(F(1/10)=156717/100\), \(F(2)=-7827\) certify the Stokes example; a standalone checker verifies signs and identity.
